title: Beyond Multimodal Alignment: Certifying Physical Language through Response Substitution and Ordered Execution
abstract: arXiv:2608.19492v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: World models increasingly treat compact multimodal representations as interfaces between perception and physical interaction, yet existing probes do not establish whether different sensors carry the same executable meaning or whether that meaning survives a new action composition. We introduce an operational capability hierarchy and the Disjoint-Bridge Operator-Substitution Certificate (DBOSC), which asks whether independently trained modality compilers enter a frozen response chart interchangeably on evidence outside their training panels. On Cluster Haptic, audio and acceleration representations of the same unseen surface are 4.5x closer in response space than wrong-surface pairings, with the gap holding for all 19 held-out surfaces; unsealing withheld responses confirms that every branch predicts the physics better than the population chart. translated_title: 超越多模态对齐：通过响应替换与有序执行验证物理语言
translated_abstract: 世界模型越来越将紧凑的多模态表示视为感知与物理交互之间的接口，然而现有探针并未确定不同传感器是否承载相同的可执行含义，或该含义是否能在新的动作组合中存续。我们引入了一个操作能力层级和不相交桥接算子替换证书（DBOSC），该证书考察独立训练的多模态编译器能否在其训练集之外的证据上，互换地进入一个冻结的响应图表。在集群触觉实验中，同一未见表面的音频和加速度表示在响应空间中比错误表面配对接近4.5倍，且这一差距在所有19个保留表面上持续存在；解封保留响应确认每个分支对物理的预测均优于总体图表。随后，我们在一个具有互补模态的受控弹塑性系统中测试了有序执行。
tldr: 本文提出DBOSC证书，证明独立训练的多模态编译器能在未见数据上互换执行物理响应，并验证了有序执行在物理系统中的可靠性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the DBOSC certificate, demonstrating that independently trained multimodal compilers can interchangeably execute physical responses on unseen data and validating ordered execution reliability in physical systems.
